entities.summary: Hubert Patrick O'Connor, OMI was a Canadian Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Prince George from 1986 until his resignation following charges of sex crimes stemming from his time as principal of Saint Joseph's Mission Residential School in Williams Lake. At the time, he was the highest ranking Catholic official in the world to be charged with a sex crime. He was a member of the Oblates of Mary Immaculate.
